## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the reason it is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] Interface or documentation only
- [ ] Packaging or environment management
- [ ] Result schema or data conversion
- [ ] Scientific algorithm behavior

## Validation

- [ ] Python files compile
- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Standard Pipeline output was checked
- [ ] Original result files remain unchanged by assisted correction
- [ ] Relevant Windows, macOS, and Linux behavior was considered
- [ ] Documentation was updated

## Scientific behavior

State explicitly whether segmentation, tracking, matching, or correction logic
changed. Scientific algorithm changes require separate validation evidence.
